scope: Current working-tree code/ and docs/ only. No repository/index mutation, no uploads, no format renaming.
root_reported_policy: Archives, binaries, model weights, datasets and binary documents are rejected by the competition hook. Source code and editable text documentation are candidates for a source-only commit; documents/static media use official CDN, research datasets/models use a separately published repository such as Zenodo.
status: Read-only proposed classification; not evidence of any successful push.
review_notes: No files were renamed to disguise formats.
All CSVs are classified outside the competition repository, including small/blank templates.
Scientific JSON/provenance exports are conservatively excluded; package manifests, schemas and authored input configurations are distinguished explicitly.
Kept Markdown/HTML can retain prose evidence but must not embed a substituted full dataset or model weights.
Plain-text KiCad/OpenSCAD and authored map/config inputs are marked for root review; the current .brd is a binary and excluded.
This classification does not assert that an unpublished Zenodo preparation is already a public download.
